title: A Rapid and Cost-Effective Pipeline to Identify and Capture BGCs From Bacterial Draft Genomes
author: Marco A. Campos-Magaña
license_note: PMC full-text XML — Bio-protocol — CC-BY confirmed in article XML
materials: Aetherobacter fasciculatus SBSr002 (Leibniz-Institute DSMZ-German Collection of Microorganisms and Cell Cultures, DSM
TransforMax EPI300 Electrocompetent E. coli (Epicentre TM , EC300110 )
E. coli DH5α competent cells (ThermoFisher Scientific, catalog number:
GenElute TM Bacterial Genomic DNA kit (Sigma-Aldrich, catalog number: NA
Agentcourt AMPure XP beads (Beckman Coulter, catalog number: A
Rapid Barcoding kit (Oxford Nanopore Technologies, catalog number: SQK-RBK
Q5 ® high-fidelity DNA polymerase (New England BioLabs, catalog number: M0491S)
Phire TM Hot Start II DNA polymerase (Thermo Scientific, catalog number: F124S)
Yeast synthetic drop-out medium supplement, without leucin, DO-Leu (Takara, catalog number:

steps.title: Grow A. fasciculatus culture
steps.instruction: Inoculate 10 mL of VY/2 media with A. fasciculatus SBSr002 and incubate at 28 °C, 200–250 rpm in vented‑cap Greiner tubes for 8–14 days; subculture at least every three weeks and change medium weekly with 10 mL fresh VY/2. If no growth after 10 days, split agar cubes, squeeze material onto agar plate and reincubate.

steps.title: Extract genomic DNA
steps.instruction: Use the GenElute™ Bacterial Genomic DNA kit for Gram‑negative bacteria to isolate DNA from 10 mL exponential/mid‑log cultures, eluting in Tris‑EDTA solution. Prepare agarose plugs (1 % agarose) following Bio‑Rad CHEF Genomic DNA Plug Kit protocol, making four plug types: 1:1 (60 µL culture), 1:2 (30 µL), 1:4 (15 µL), 1:8 (7.5 µL).

steps.title: Concentrate DNA with beads
steps.instruction: Add 180 µL (1.8×) Agentcourt AMPure XP beads to 100 µL genomic DNA, mix, incubate, place on magnet, wash twice with 70 % ethanol, air‑dry 5 min, elute in 10 µL nuclease‑free water.

steps.title: Prepare Rapid Barcoding kit
steps.instruction: Thaw all Rapid Barcoding kit components (Fragmentation mix RB01‑12, Rapid adapter (RAP), Sequencing buffer (SQB), Loading beads (LB), Flush buffer (FLB)‑1, Flush tether (FLT)) at room temperature, briefly spin down, and mix by pipetting (vortex SQB and FLB before spin).

steps.title: Set up fragmentation reaction
steps.instruction: Resuspend purified DNA in nuclease‑free water, transfer ~400 ng (adjust to 7.5 µL total) into a 0.2 mL thin‑walled PCR tube, add 2.5 µL Fragmentation mix RB01‑12, mix by finger‑flick, spin down.

steps.title: Fragment DNA
steps.instruction: Incubate tube at 30 °C for 1 min, then at 80 °C for 1 min, place on ice for ~2 min to cool.

steps.title: Pool barcoded samples
steps.instruction: Combine all barcoded reactions in a 1.5 mL LoBind tube (≈10 µL per sample).

steps.title: AMPure bead cleanup of pool
steps.instruction: Vortex AMPure XP beads to resuspend, add an equal volume of beads to the pooled sample, mix by flick, incubate on Hula mixer 5 min at RT; prepare 500 µL fresh 70 % ethanol, place tube on magnet, discard supernatant, wash beads twice with 200 µL 70 % ethanol, remove residual ethanol, air‑dry 5 min, elute in 10 µL 10 mM Tris‑HCl pH 7.5–8.0 with 50 mM NaCl, incubate 2 min RT, pellet beads, retain 10 µL eluate.

steps.title: Add rapid adapter
steps.instruction: Add 1 µL RAP to the 10 µL barcoded DNA, mix by finger‑flick, spin down, incubate 5 min at RT. Keep library on ice until loading.

steps.title: Prime MinION flow cell
steps.instruction: Thaw SQB, LB, FLT and one tube of Flush buffer (FB) at RT; vortex each tube and spin down. Open MinION Mk1B, slide flow cell under clip, open priming port clockwise. Using a P1000 set to 200 µL, draw 220–230 µL from priming port to remove bubbles, confirming continuous buffer across sensor array. Prepare priming mix by adding 30 µL FLT to FB, vortex. Load 800 µL priming mix into priming port, wait 5 min.

substeps.instruction: Thaw and vortex SQB, LB, FLT, FB.
Open flow cell and priming port.
Remove bubbles by drawing ~220 µL from priming port.
Mix 30 µL FLT with FB to make priming mix.
Load 800 µL priming mix via priming port; wait 5 min.

steps.title: Prepare library loading mix
steps.instruction: Vortex LB tubes thoroughly. In a new tube combine 34 µL SQB, 25.5 µL LB (mixed immediately before use), 4.5 µL nuclease‑free water, and 11 µL DNA library.

steps.title: Load library onto flow cell
steps.instruction: Gently lift SpotON sample port cover, load 200 µL of the priming mix (from previous step) via priming port (not SpotON). Mix library gently by pipetting, then add 75 µL library to SpotON sample port dropwise, ensuring each drop enters before the next. Replace SpotON cover, close priming port, install light shield, close device lid.

substeps.instruction: Load 200 µL priming mix via priming port.
Mix library, load 75 µL into SpotON port dropwise.
Replace SpotON cover, close priming port, install light shield.

steps.title: Run sequencing
steps.instruction: Start MinKNOW, configure run to store Fast5 raw data files, and begin sequencing.

steps.title: Base‑call and demultiplex
steps.instruction: Run Guppy v4.4.1 with command: guppy_basecaller --input_path "input folder" --save_path "output folder" --barcode_kits SQK‑RBK004 --trim_barcodes.

steps.title: Assemble reads with Flye
steps.instruction: Execute Flye v2.9.5: Flye --nano-raw "inputfile.fastq" --out-dir "output folder".

steps.title: Polish assembly with Medaka
steps.instruction: Run Medaka v1.12.0: medaka_consensus -i "basecalled sample" -d "assembled fastq file" -o "output folder".

steps.title: Identify BGCs with antiSMASH
steps.instruction: Upload draft assembly to antiSMASH 7.1 using command: run_antismash input.fasta outputfolder --genefinding-tool prodigal --cb-general --cb-knownclusters --cb-subclusters --asf --pfam2go --smcog‑trees.

steps.title: Assess assembly quality
steps.instruction: Run CheckM v1.2.3 (checkm lineage_wf; checkm qa; checkm lineage) and BUSCO v5.6.0 (busco -i -o -l -m genome).

steps.title: Annotate genome with Bakta
steps.instruction: Execute: bakta --db /path/to/bakta_db --output bakta_out genome.fasta.

steps.title: Classify genes with COGclassifier
steps.instruction: Run: COGclassifier -i -o E.

steps.title: Amplify oriT element
steps.instruction: PCR amplify oriT from pk18mobsacB using primers 1–2 (Table S1) with Q5® high‑fidelity polymerase under thermocycling conditions: 98 °C 10 min; 30 × (98 °C 20 s, 50–72 °C 20 s, 72 °C 20–30 s/kb); 72 °C 2–10 min; hold 10 °C.

steps.title: Digest oriT and pCC1FOS
steps.instruction: In CutSmart® Buffer, digest 1 µg each of the oriT amplicon and pCC1FOS with HpaI and BamHI‑HF (5–10 U enzyme per µg DNA). Use insert‑to‑plasmid ratio 1:1–3:1 for downstream ligation.

steps.title: Purify digested DNA
steps.instruction: Clean digests with NucleoSpin Gel and PCR Clean‑up kit according to manufacturer’s instructions.

steps.title: Ligate pCC1FOS‑oriT
steps.instruction: Set up ligation with T4 DNA ligase and its buffer, incubate 1 h at RT (insert‑to‑plasmid ratio 1:1–3:1).

steps.title: Transform ligation into E. coli DH5α
steps.instruction: Thaw DH5α competent cells on ice, add 10 µL ligation, incubate 30 min on ice, heat‑shock 90 s at 42 °C, ice 5 min, add 1 mL pre‑warmed LB, shake 37 °C 60 min at 750 rpm. Plate 100 µL on LB agar + chloramphenicol 34 µg/mL, spread, incubate overnight 37 °C. Pick colonies, grow 10 mL LB + chloramphenicol 34 µg/mL, 37 °C 250 rpm overnight, isolate plasmid with GeneJET kit.

steps.title: Linearize pCC1FOS‑oriT by PCR
steps.instruction: PCR amplify 1 µg pCC1FOS‑oriT using primers 2 and 3 (Table S1) with Q5® polymerase under the same thermocycling conditions as above.

steps.title: Amplify CEN/ARS from pRS314
steps.instruction: PCR amplify CEN/ARS using primers 4–5 (Table S1) with Q5® polymerase under the same thermocycling conditions.

steps.title: Amplify gentamicin resistance gene
steps.instruction: PCR amplify GmR from pSEVA62 using primers 6–7 (Table S1) with Q5® polymerase under the same thermocycling conditions.

steps.title: Fuse CEN/ARS‑GmR‑lox66
steps.instruction: Perform overlap PCR with primers 4 and 7 to fuse CEN/ARS, GmR, and lox66, using Q5® polymerase under the same thermocycling conditions.

steps.title: Golden Gate assemble CEN/ARS‑GmR‑lox66
steps.instruction: Dilute fragment, then in 8 µL total add 2 µL Golden Gate mix, 1 µL linearized pSB1C3 vector, 1 µL insert, water to 8 µL. Thermocycle: 37 °C 20 min × 1; 16 °C 4 min × 30; 37 °C 3 min × 50; 80 °C 10 min × 1.

steps.title: Linearize CEN/ARS‑GmR‑lox66 fragment
steps.instruction: PCR amplify 300 ng of the assembled cassette using primers 4 and 7 (Table S1) with Q5® polymerase under the same thermocycling conditions.

steps.title: Amplify LEU2 from pRS315
steps.instruction: PCR amplify LEU2 using primers 8–9 (Table S1) with Q5® polymerase under the same thermocycling conditions.

steps.title: Amplify Cre recombinase
steps.instruction: PCR amplify Cre from iGEM part BBa_K112122 using primers 10–11 (Table S1) with Q5® polymerase under the same thermocycling conditions.

steps.title: Assemble CRE‑LEU2‑loxm2/71 by overlap PCR
steps.instruction: Perform overlap PCR with primers 12–15 to fuse Cre, LEU2, and loxm2/71 using Q5® polymerase under the same thermocycling conditions.

steps.title: Golden Gate assemble CRE‑LEU2‑loxm2/71
steps.instruction: Dilute target fragment, then in 8 µL total add 2 µL Golden Gate mix, 1 µL linearized pSB1C3 vector, 1 µL insert, water to 8 µL. Thermocycle as above (37 °C 20 min × 1; 16 °C 4 min × 30; 37 °C 3 min × 50; 80 °C 10 min × 1).

steps.title: Linearize CRE‑LEU2‑lox2/71 fragment
steps.instruction: PCR amplify 300 ng of the assembled CRE‑LEU2‑lox2/71 cassette using primers 12 and 13 (Table S1) with Q5® polymerase under the same thermocycling conditions.

steps.title: Linearize lanthipeptide BGC fragments
steps.instruction: PCR amplify each of the five BGC fragments (300 ng each) using primers 16–25 (Table S1) with Q5® polymerase under the same thermocycling conditions. Design each fragment with 60‑bp overhangs for TAR cloning.

steps.title: Start yeast pre‑culture (Day 1)
steps.instruction: Inoculate 50 µL glycerol stock of S. cerevisiae W303‑1a into 5 mL appropriate medium (e.g., YPDA or minimal SD‑LEU) in a 500 mL Erlenmeyer flask; incubate overnight at 30 °C, 190 rpm.

steps.title: Grow yeast to OD 2 (Day 2)
steps.instruction: Measure OD₆₀₀ (dilution 1/10) in the morning, dilute culture in 5 mL medium to reach OD₆₀₀ ≈ 2 by 6 pm; re‑measure at ~2 pm and 6 pm, adjusting as needed. Calculate dilution for next day using C₁V₁ = C₂V₂ to obtain final OD₆₀₀ = 0.000061035 in 100 mL.

steps.title: Inoculate larger yeast cultures (Day 2‑3)
steps.instruction: Inoculate two 100 mL cultures in 500 mL flasks with the calculated microliter volume, incubate at 30 °C, 190 rpm until OD₆₀₀ reaches 2.6–2.8 (≈4 pm).

steps.title: Harvest and store yeast cells
steps.instruction: Centrifuge cultures at 1,892 × g for 3 min at RT, resuspend each pellet in 20 mL 1 M sorbitol, split into two 50 mL tubes, centrifuge again, resuspend each pellet in 20 mL sorbitol, store at 4 °C overnight.

steps.title: Prepare spheroplasts (Day 4)
steps.instruction: Collect cells, centrifuge 1,892 × g 3 min RT, resuspend pellet in 10 mL SPEM, add 20 µL β‑mercaptoethanol and 20 µL Zymolyase‑100T, incubate 5 min with mild agitation (avoid over‑incubation). Verify spheroplast formation by measuring OD₆₀₀ of two samples: A (150 µL culture + 1.35 mL 1 M sorbitol) and B (150 µL culture + 1.35 mL 2 % SDS); target A≈0.8, B≈0.2 (ratio 3–4). Take readings every 2 min until ratio achieved.

steps.title: Recover spheroplasts
steps.instruction: Add 40 mL 1 M sorbitol, invert to mix, centrifuge 1,314 × g 5 min at 4 °C; discard supernatant, resuspend pellet in 20 mL sorbitol using 25 mL pipette; add another 30 mL sorbitol, invert, centrifuge 1,314 × g 5 min at 4 °C; discard supernatant, remove last drops, resuspend gently in 1 mL STC, rotate 10 min RT. Keep spheroplasts on ice (or at RT) for up to 1 h.

steps.title: Aliquot linear DNA fragments
steps.instruction: In a 1.5 mL tube combine: a) 1 µg PCR‑linearized pCC1FOS‑oriT, b) 300 ng linearized CEN/ARS‑GmR‑lox66, c) 300 ng linearized CRE‑LEU2‑loxm2/71, d) 300 ng each of the five lanthipeptide BGC amplicons.

steps.title: Transform DNA into yeast spheroplasts
steps.instruction: Add 100 µL spheroplast suspension to the DNA mixture, flick gently, incubate 10 min RT. Add 0.5 mL 20 % PEG, invert 4× strongly, incubate 20 min RT.

steps.title: Recover transformed yeast cells
steps.instruction: Centrifuge at 4,643 × g 5 min RT, resuspend pellet in 700 µL SOS, incubate 2 h at 30 °C.

steps.title: Plate transformed yeast
steps.instruction: Transfer 700 µL cell suspension to a 15 mL tube, add 12 mL TOP agar‑leu (pre‑warmed to 55 °C), invert 4–5× gently, pour onto plate, let solidify, incubate 30 °C. Colonies appear in 3–5 days.

steps.title: Patch colonies onto SD‑leu plates
steps.instruction: Pick yeast transformant colonies, streak onto SD‑leu plates, incubate 30 °C for 1–2 days.

steps.title: Colony PCR screening
steps.instruction: Prepare Phire™ Hot Start II master mix (Table 3 primers) for 20 µL reactions. Pick individual colonies with sterile tips, dip tip into PCR tube containing master mix, discard tip. Run thermocycler: 98 °C 10 min; 20 × (98 °C 15 s, 50–72 °C 15 s, 72 °C 10 s/kb); 72 °C 1 min; hold 10 °C.

steps.title: Run agarose gel electrophoresis
steps.instruction: Prepare 100 mL 1 % agarose in 1× TAE with 10 µL MIDORI Green Easy, cast in wide mini‑sub cell with 2 × 26‑well combs. Add 1× TAE to cover gel, load 4 µL 1 kb Plus ladder in first well, add 4 µL 6× loading dye to each PCR reaction, load 10 µL of each PCR product starting in well 2. Run at 100 V constant for 30 min, visualize with gel doc XR.

steps.title: Select positive yeast colonies
steps.instruction: Identify colonies showing amplicon sizes listed in Table 3 (0.6, 0.7, 1.5, 1.7 kb). Grow positive colonies overnight at 30 °C, 250 rpm in 10 mL SD minimal media lacking leucine.

steps.title: Extract total yeast DNA
steps.instruction: Use Yeast DNA Extraction kit per manufacturer’s instructions to isolate DNA from the overnight culture.

steps.title: Electroporate DNA into E. coli EPI300
steps.instruction: Place chilled DNA solution and chilled 0.2 cm gap electroporation cuvette on ice, load cuvette, electroporate with Gene Pulser settings: 2.5 kV, 25 µF, 200 Ω. Immediately add 1 mL LB, transfer to 1.5 mL tube, shake 37 °C 1 h, 250 rpm.

steps.title: Select E. coli transformants
steps.instruction: Plate 100 µL electroporated cells on LB agar containing gentamycin 15 µg/mL, incubate 37 °C 1–2 days. For colonies, centrifuge 7,200 × g 1 min RT, remove most medium, resuspend remaining in fresh LB with gentamycin, spread, incubate 37 °C.

steps.title: Isolate plasmid from E. coli
steps.instruction: Grow positive colonies overnight 37 °C, 250 rpm in 10 mL LB + gentamycin 15 µg/mL, isolate plasmid using GeneJET Plasmid Miniprep kit per manufacturer’s protocol.

steps.title: Verify plasmid sequence
steps.instruction: Submit isolated plasmid from EPI300 for whole‑plasmid sequencing (Plasmidsaurus inc.) and confirm BGC assembly.
